@menuAbout.description: The application menu's item that shows the system's About panel.

settingsTransfersHint: Higher values transfer faster but use more network bandwidth.
settingsCheckersHint: Higher values compare files faster but put more load on the server.
settingsRetriesHint: The number of times a failed operation is retried.
settingsBandwidthHint: Limits the transfer speed of each run. Useful for a NAS on Wi-Fi or a slow connection.

@settingsSpeed.description: A speed cap, in megabytes per second.

settingsTrash: Keep deleted and replaced files for
settingsTrashHint: Copies and syncs move the files they delete or replace into the .cloudshuttle-trash folder of the destination, and empty what is older. A task can choose its own. When off, the files are deleted right away.
settingsExcludeEnabled: Apply these rules to every run
settingsExcludeEnabledHint: Copies and syncs leave them out on both sides. Turn this off to stop applying these rules; every task's own rules still apply.
settingsExcludeRulesHint: {count, plural, one {# rule, applied to every task} other {# rules, applied to every task}}

@settingsExcludeRulesHint.description: How many global exclusion rules every run uses.

settingsExcludeRulesOff: {count, plural, one {# rule, not applied while this is off} other {# rules, not applied while this is off}}

@settingsExcludeRulesOff.description: The global rules' count while the switch that applies them is off.

settingsExcludeDialogHint: One rule per line. A rule ending with / matches a folder and everything in it. Only a rule starting with / is anchored to the top; every other rule matches at any depth. * matches any characters in a name, ** also across folders.
settingsExcludeInvalidLine: Line {line} isn't a valid rule. Check that its brackets and braces are closed.
settingsExcludeFailed: A rule isn't valid. Click Edit… to fix it.
settingsNotifySkipped: Notify when a scheduled run cannot start
settingsNotifyStale: Notify when a scheduled task hasn't succeeded for
settingsNotifyStaleHint: Only tasks that run on a schedule. A task that has never succeeded is counted from when its schedule was set.

@settingsStaleDaysValue.description: A choice for how long a scheduled task may go without succeeding.

settingsRetentionHint: Older runs and logs are deleted. Synced files are not affected.

@settingsKeepDays.description: How long the history is kept.

settingsBackupICloud: Back up the configuration to iCloud Drive
settingsBackupICloudHint: Stores an encrypted copy of your storages, tasks and settings in the CloudShuttle folder in iCloud Drive, updated after each change. Secrets remain in the system keychain.
settingsBackupPasswordHint: Required to restore a backup. If the password is lost, the backup cannot be opened.
settingsBackupPasswordSet: Set. Required to restore a backup. If the password is lost, the backup cannot be opened.
settingsBackupPasswordMissing: Backups are paused. Backups are now encrypted; set a password to resume.
errorPasswordRequired: Set a password to encrypt backups.
restoreHint: Replaces the storages, tasks and settings with those in a backup. Run history is kept.
restoreMessage: The storages, tasks and settings in the backup will replace the current ones. Run history is kept. Backups do not include storage passwords; after restoring on another computer, enter them again.
restorePasswordHint: The password set when the backup was created. Unencrypted backups from earlier versions do not require a password.
restoreWrongPassword: The password is incorrect, or the backup has been modified since it was created.
restoreNotBackup: This file is not a CloudShuttle backup.
restoreRunsActive: Tasks are running. Restore after they finish.
restoreNewer: This backup was created by a newer version of CloudShuttle. Update the app to restore it.
settingsApplied: Changes apply to runs started after saving.
errorOutOfRange: Choose a value within the allowed range.
errorICloudUnavailable: Turn on iCloud Drive in System Settings to enable backups.

@overviewFailingTasks.description: How many tasks failed on their last run, when more than one.

overviewNoRuns: No runs yet. Runs appear here after a task runs.

@rcloneVersion.description: The version of rclone compiled into the app: the About panel's credits, and under the overview where the system has no About panel.

tasksEmpty: No tasks yet. A task copies or syncs a folder to a storage, manually or on a schedule.

@tasksNextRun.description: When a scheduled task runs next, already formatted.

taskRunAnywayMessage: This sync may delete most of the files in the destination, or all of them if the source is empty. Continue only if this is intended.
taskRunAnywayTrash: Deleted files are moved into the .cloudshuttle-trash folder of the destination and kept for {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
taskTrashFollow: As in settings ({count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}})
taskTrashHint: Files this task deletes or replaces are moved into the .cloudshuttle-trash folder of the destination.
taskTrashOffHint: Files this task deletes or replaces are not kept.

@taskExcludeRules.description: Summary of a task's exclusion rules.

taskExcludeRulesAndLarger: {count, plural, one {# rule} other {# rules}}, and files over {size}
taskExcludeFailed: A rule isn't valid. Click Edit… to fix it.
taskExcludeHint: Runs don't copy these files, and a sync doesn't delete them from the destination.
taskExcludePatternsHint: One per line. * matches any characters in a name, ** also across folders. End a rule with / for a folder. Only a rule starting with / is anchored to the top of the source or the destination; every other rule matches at any depth.
taskExcludeInvalidLine: Line {line} isn't a valid rule. Check that its brackets and braces are closed.
taskExcludeGlobalHint: {count, plural, one {Every run also applies # global rule.} other {Every run also applies # global rules.}}

@taskExcludeGlobalHint.description: Under a task's own exclusions: the rules the settings apply to every run as well.

taskExcludeUnreadable: The saved rules can't be read, so runs won't start. Save the task with the rules you want.

@taskActions.description: Accessible name of a task's actions menu.

@taskStarted.description: Toast after a task starts by hand.

taskFieldPrefixHint: Leave empty for the top of the bucket.
taskFieldSharePathHint: Starts with the share name, for example Documents/Photos. Click Browse to choose one.
taskRelayHint: Neither location is on this computer, so files are relayed through it. A wired connection is recommended for better speed.
browseHint: Double-click a folder or press Return to open it.
browseEmpty: This folder has no subfolders. Choose this folder, or use the path above to go back.
browseShareHint: Share not listed? After a share is renamed, the NAS may list it under its old name for some time. Enter the share name to open it.
browseShareGone: The share {share} no longer exists on the server and may have been renamed. Choose the share again.
scheduleDayOfMonth: The {day, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}}

@scheduleWeekly.description: A weekly schedule: the days are joined with scheduleDaySeparator.

@scheduleDaySeparator.description: Goes between the days of a weekly schedule.

scheduleMonthly: Monthly on the {day, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} at {time}
scheduleBySystem: Runs even after CloudShuttle quits. Runs missed while the computer was off or asleep run once when it starts up or wakes.
scheduleInApp: Runs only while CloudShuttle is running, including when its window is closed.
scheduleBlocked: CloudShuttle is not allowed to run in the background. Scheduled tasks run only while CloudShuttle is running.
scheduleAskOnSave: After saving, you will be asked whether scheduled tasks may run after CloudShuttle quits.
scheduleInAppChosen: Runs only while CloudShuttle is running, including when its window is closed. You can change this in Settings.
backgroundAskTitle: Allow scheduled tasks to run after CloudShuttle quits?
backgroundAskMessage: CloudShuttle will add a background item to Login Items & Extensions in macOS. At each scheduled time, the system starts it in the background to run tasks, whether or not CloudShuttle is running. Runs missed while the computer was off or asleep run once when it starts up or wakes.
backgroundAskNote: If you choose Only while running, tasks that come due after CloudShuttle quits run the next time it opens. You can change this at any time in Settings.
settingsBackground: Run scheduled tasks after CloudShuttle quits
settingsBackgroundHint: The system starts CloudShuttle's background item at the scheduled times; it is listed in System Settings > General > Login Items & Extensions. When off, scheduled tasks run only while CloudShuttle is running.

@scheduleOpenSettings.description: Opens System Settings > General > Login Items, where the person allows apps in the background.

taskScheduleLastDay: In months without a {day, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}}, runs on the last day of the month.
modeCopyHint: Copies new and changed files and overwrites files in the destination that differ. Never deletes files.
modeSyncHint: Makes the destination identical to the source; files not in the source are deleted from the destination. If a sync would delete most of the destination, it stops for confirmation.
storagesEmpty: No storages yet. Add an S3-compatible bucket, such as Amazon S3 or Cloudflare R2, or an SMB server such as a NAS.
checkNoneHint: Test the connection to verify that the storage is available.
storageDeleteMessage: Its secret access key will be removed from the system keychain. Files in the bucket are not affected.
storageDeleteMessageShare: Its password will be removed from the system keychain. Files on the server are not affected.
storageInUse: This storage is used by a task. Edit or delete the task first.
storageEndpointHint: The S3 API URL of the service. Leave empty for Amazon S3.
storagePlaintextWarning: This address uses http://, so keys and files are transmitted without encryption. Use https:// unless this is a trusted server on your local network.
storageRegionHint: Optional for most providers. For Cloudflare R2, enter auto.
storageSecretHint: Stored in the system keychain, not in the app's database.
storageSecretKeptHint: Stored in the system keychain. Leave empty to keep the current key.
storageHostHint: Host name or IP address, for example nas.local or 192.168.1.20.
storageServersUnverified: These servers were discovered by network broadcast and have not been verified. Confirm that the address belongs to your device before signing in.
storageUsernameHint: For shares that allow guest access, enter guest.
storagePasswordHint: Stored in the system keychain. Can be left empty when the user name is guest.
storagePasswordKeptHint: Stored in the system keychain. Leave empty to keep the current password.
storageSharesNone: The server has no shares accessible to this account.
storageServersNone: No SMB servers found. For servers that do not use Bonjour, enter the address directly. If macOS requested local network access, allow it and search again.

errorInvalidUrl: Enter a URL that starts with https://.
errorInvalidHost: Enter a host name or an IP address, such as nas.local.
errorUnreachable: Unable to reach the server. Make sure it is turned on and connected to this network.
errorAuthFailed: The server rejected the user name or password, or this account does not have access to the share.
errorShareNotFound: The server has no share with this name. Click Browse to choose one of its shares.
errorShareRequired: Choose a share on the server, or a folder in one.
errorNotAbsolute: Enter a full path, such as /Users/name/Documents.
errorSameLocation: The source and the destination are the same.
errorNested: One folder is inside the other. Choose folders that do not contain each other.

errorNameTaken: This name is already in use.
errorTaskRunning: The task is running. Stop it first.
errorDestinationBusy: Another task is currently writing to this destination. Run this task after it finishes.

runProblemLargeDelete: The sync stopped because it would delete most of the files in the destination. No files were deleted. To proceed, run the task with Run anyway.

settingsAppearanceHint: Takes effect immediately. System matches the macOS appearance.
settingsAppIconDockAndMenuBarHint: Shows the app in both places. Closing the window hides the Dock icon; reopening from the menu bar restores it.
settingsAppIconDockHint: Shows the app only in the Dock. After its window closes, the Dock icon opens it again.
settingsAppIconMenuBarHint: Shows the app only in the menu bar. After its window closes, the menu bar icon opens it again.

@updatesVersion.description: The version running now, in the settings' Updates card.

updatesWaiting: {count, plural, one {Restarts when the running task finishes.} other {Restarts when the # running tasks finish.}}

@updatesWaiting.description: After the person asked to restart into an update while tasks run: the app waits for them.

updatesCheckFailed: Could not check for updates. Check your network connection and try again.
updatesInstallFailed: Could not install the update. Try again, or download it from the download page.
updatesUnavailable: This copy of CloudShuttle cannot update itself. Move it to the Applications folder, or get new versions from the download page.
settingsCheckUpdatesHint: Checks once a day. Takes effect immediately.
settingsInstallUpdatesHint: CloudShuttle restarts into a new version when no task is running and its window is closed.

@menuCheckUpdates.description: The application menu's and status menu's item that checks for a newer version.

notifyUpdateBody: Click to see what's new and install it.
taskAllowRoot: Allow transfer into the selected folder directly
taskAllowRootHint: Off by default. Creates a source-named subfolder; if it already exists, choose whether to reuse it or create a numbered folder.
taskDestinationExistsHint: Use this folder to update matching files (sync may also delete files), or create a separate numbered folder. Later runs will keep using the chosen folder.
taskDestinationFileHint: A file already uses this name. Create a separate numbered folder.
runProblemDestinationChanged: The destination name became occupied before the first transfer. No files were changed. Edit and save the task to choose an existing or numbered folder.
